description: Re-examines the PR #1999 metallic negative at convention D. The illustration is stale (q_0 off by 1.3e-8), plots chi^(2,1)(sigma_1 sigma_2) = h^2-1 where convention D gives the constant -1, and plots bare characters while claiming weighted ones; its own curve flips sign at the golden rung it says nothing flips at. Under D y_alt = 0, so only two blocks are live, and y_sym = (h^2+2)/(h^2+4), y_std = 1/[2]_q^2. Under the q-Plancherel weighting T(sigma) = (h/2) T(gamma) identically at every n — from W_lambda = W_lambda' plus the transpose-pair character sum — so the cost coincidence is at h = 2 = delta_silver for every strand count, generalising the Lean silver_lp_coincidence from n = 2. Under the convention-D Markov weighting the ratio is z = q^2/[2]_q instead and the coincidence moves to the supergolden ratio q^3 = q^2+1. S(3) also contains a non-metallic locus, refuting S(n) subset {delta_1..delta_n}.
caveats: The all-n statement is conditional on GaloisPairCharacterSum (chi^lambda(sigma) + chi^lambda'(sigma) = dim(lambda) h), which is a conjecture CLASS in MetallicLPIdentities.lean, not a theorem — symbolically verified there for n = 3, 4. This probe verifies the resulting identity outright at n = 2 and n = 3 and verifies the other input, W_lambda = W_lambda', at n = 2..5.

Two weightings are in play and neither is 'the' right one. The q-Plancherel measure d_q^2/sum d_q^2 is what pyhecke's regime_scanner uses and what the Lean silver theorem's cost vector turns out to be; the convention-D Markov trace y_lambda is what the atom LP is actually built on. The finding is that the metallic ladder is a feature of the FORMER, so a metallic result cannot be transported into the atom LP without first settling which functional the physics is supposed to extremise.

The withdrawal is of a CITATION, not of a measurement. metallic_ladder_regime_test_probe.py's own H_3 Gram-signature and H_9 selection sweeps are unaffected and still show no metallic feature — because, as shown here, they are Markov-weighted. Its appeal to PR #1999 as independent corroboration, and its framing of 'representation-theoretic regime' versus 'optimisation regime' as distinct, are both withdrawn.
